$Comment: The third find tier, from cycle 50 onward, which covers most of a long session. Offcuts double to two pulls from the shared byproduct list, and essence becomes near-certain on a winning roll (95 percent for 2 to 4) with a 2 percent chance of a single CONCENTRATED essence instead. The deep tier nearly always pays because its scarcity is carried by the parent roll's own 15 percent chance rather than by this table being stingy.
